_note: Synthesized caller for 'Watch a demo call' (design section 8, lines C1-C7). scripts/make-demo-audio.ps1 turns these into web/public/demo/<id>.wav (en-US Zira, 24 kHz mono PCM16). The WAVs are generated locally and not committed. `parts` adds pauses; `bargeIn` makes the line cut into the agent's plan reading.

lines.text: Hi. I run a small ramen place near Mangwon Market. We opened in the spring. Weekends are fine, but weekday lunch is empty.
Maybe four or five hundred thousand won a month.
Wait. Cut it to three hundred eighty thousand. And can you take twenty percent off?
